description: Convert one cooking amount between units, using ingredient density for volume↔weight (e.g. 1 cup flour → grams). Pure calculation: reads and writes nothing. For a whole recipe use get_recipe units=metric instead. Returns {from, to, amount, unit}, e.g. {from: "1 cup", to: "120 g", amount: 120, unit: "g"}.

amount.description: Quantity: number or fraction text, e.g. 1.5, "1 1/2", "3/4"

ingredient.description: Ingredient for density-based volume↔weight, e.g. "flour", "sugar"; optional

name: convert_units
title: Convert a measurement
